title: Extending ISC: Building a Custom Campaign Email Reminder System

c: A frequently requested feature on the SailPoint Ideas Portal (GOV-I-799) is the ability to configure the frequency of campaign email reminders. By default, SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) sends automated reminder emails once a week throughout the campaign lifecycle. However, out-of-the-box (OOTB) functionality does not currently support adjusting this interval or automatically stopping reminders once a campaign passes its deadline.
Best suited for standard, recurring certifications where a predictable, weekly follow-up schedule meets business requirements.

Recommended for high-priority compliance cycles (such as SOX or executive entitlement reviews) with strict, compressed deadlines requiring follow-ups every 1 to 3 days, daily reminders as deadlines approach, or consolidated notifications across multiple active campaigns.

The fixed weekly reminder schedule offers limited flexibility. When campaigns require an accelerated follow-up cadence, or when administrators need notifications to cease strictly at the campaign deadline, native configuration options cannot accommodate those requirements.

The solution presented in this article provides end-to-end control over certification campaign email follow-ups. By combining an interactive form, a SailPoint workflow, and PowerShell scripts executed through Privileged Task Automation (PTA) via the Privileged Access Gateway (PAG), administrators can fully customize reminder intervals and consolidate multiple campaign notifications into a single reviewer email.
1 Form + 1 Workflow + 2 PowerShell Scripts + 1 HTML Email Template.

Through an interactive form, administrators can select active campaigns, determine if they want to send an immediate reminder, configure the time frequency (in days), and decide if reminders should stop once the end date is reached. The workflow calculates the necessary iterations using an inline PowerShell script and uses a serial loop to pause (Wait step) and execute the reminder emails via a second PowerShell script running via PTA.
Select All Active Campaigns Or Individual Campaigns - Toggle Field
Campaign Selector - Dropdown Field (Only appears if the toggle above is set to false)
Send Reminder Now? - Toggle Field (Controls whether to send an immediate reminder or wait until the first frequency interval hits)
Stop on End Date? - Toggle Field (Controls whether notifications should stop if the campaign due date has passed)
Select Time Frequency - Dropdown Field (1-15 Days)

We use an interactive form to act as a launcher for the workflow. This allows administrators to quickly select the target campaigns and define the frequency parameters without hardcoding anything. The form utilizes dynamic showing/hiding so the campaign selector only appears if you opt not to select all active campaigns.

Before launching this custom workflow, review your campaign definition or campaign template settings in ISC. To prevent reviewers from receiving redundant notifications, consider disabling or adjusting the built-in reminder schedule when relying on this workflow for notifications.

Ensure only one workflow instance runs for a given set of campaigns at a time. Launching multiple concurrent workflow instances targeting the same campaigns will cause reviewers to receive duplicate emails on overlapping schedules.

The sample scripts include placeholder variables for demonstration purposes. In production environments, never hardcode client secrets or SMTP passwords. Instead, retrieve credentials securely using Windows Credential Manager, system environment variables on the PAG/PTA host, or an enterprise secret store (such as CyberArk or HashiCorp Vault).

Because workflow executions in ISC have a 30-day maximum lifecycle,
caps the iteration count to 30 days. If your certification campaign remains active past 30 days, simply relaunch the interactive form to initiate a new reminder cycle.

If a campaign concludes early, or if administrators wish to alter the reminder frequency mid-campaign, navigate to the ISC Workflows dashboard and cancel the in-flight execution. A new workflow run can then be launched with updated parameters.

This solution addresses a common requirement in identity governance by giving administrators full autonomy over certification reminder frequency. By combining interactive forms, workflows, and Privileged Task Automation (PTA), organizations can implement flexible, consolidated reminder schedules tailored to their governance requirements.
